# Fuzz seed corpus (QAP-08 / SEC-001)

Seed inputs for `crates/veskra-qa/tests/fuzz_smoke.rs`, a deterministic mutation fuzzer that
checks Veskra's parsers and command boundary for panics, time and heap bounds. Every file is
**generated by Veskra itself** (or copied from Veskra-generated fixtures). None is a third-party
artwork, brush pack, Adobe file or downloaded corpus. Total size is asserted to be < 1 MB
(currently about 60 KB).

Regenerate (deterministic; running it twice gives byte-identical files):

```sh
VESKRA_REGEN_FUZZ_CORPUS=1 cargo test -p veskra-qa --test fuzz_smoke corpus
```

| Directory | Files | Origin | Fuzz target |
|---|---|---|---|
| `icc/` | `veskra-srgb-v4.icc`, `veskra-display-p3-v4.icc` | `veskra_color::IccProfile::{srgb, display_p3}()` bytes | `IccProfile::parse` + `RgbTransform::new` |
| `icc/` | `lcms2-builtin-srgb.icc` | Copy of `tests/fixtures/color/icc/lcms2-builtin-srgb.icc` (LittleCMS 2.19 `cmsCreate_sRGBProfile()` output; provenance in `tests/fixtures/color/LICENSES.md`) | same |
| `veskra/` | `layers-groups-selection.veskra` | 64×48 document built with engine commands: rough pencil, vector ink layer, clipped Multiply layer filled through an ellipse selection, 70 % group with charcoal, hidden layer (selection persisted) | `veskra_format::{decode, inspect, read_preview}` |
| `veskra/` | `tiny-transparent.veskra` | 24×16 document with a semi-transparent background | same |
| `veskra/` | `future-schema.veskra` | Copy of `tests/fixtures/documents/future-schema.veskra` (FMT, forward-compat path) | same |
| `psd/` | `layers-groups-clip.psd` | PSD export of the 64×48 document (groups, clipping, Multiply, hidden layer, ICC 1039) | `inspect_psd(keep_pixels=true)` + `PsdExporter::validate` |
| `png/` | `rgba-icc.png`, `rgba-srgb-chunk.png` | PNG export of the 24×16 document with `iCCP` / with `sRGB` chunk | `PngExporter::validate` |
| `svg/` | `hybrid.svg`, `vector-only-noicc.svg` | SVG exports of the 64×48 document (both toggles; vector only without ICC) | `SvgExporter::validate` |
| `pdf/` | `hybrid.pdf`, `vector-only-noicc.pdf` | PDF exports of the same | `PdfExporter::validate` |
| `input/` | `*.bin` | Packed JNI pointer batches (`pack_events`) of **synthetic** sequences from `veskra_qa::events`: stylus stroke with historical + predicted events, two-finger pinch, palm + stylus, stylus-eraser ended by `ACTION_CANCEL` | `unpack_events` + `Session::input_batch` |
| `commands/` | `commands.jsonl` | One hand-written JSON command per command family (`docs/COMMANDS.md`) | `Session::execute_json` |

`input/*.bin` layout (little-endian): `"VQIN"`, `count u32`, `n_ints u32`, `n_floats u32`,
`n_longs u32`, then the `ints` (i32), `floats` (f32) and `longs` (i64) arrays of CONTRACTS §8.
The harness decodes leniently (arrays contain only the bytes present, `count` is passed through
unchanged) so mutations reach `unpack_events`' own length/count validation.

Crash reproducers found by the fuzzer are written to `target/qa/fuzz/crashes-<iters>/` (not
committed). A minimized reproducer for a confirmed defect should be added here under
`<target>/regress-<id>.<ext>` together with a row in this table.
